sentences.text:
Heard on I.A. No.20120/2022, which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail,
filed by the appellant.
The appellant has been convicted by the trial Court under Section 376 (2) (cha)(dhha) of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.5,000/-, with default stipulation.
Earlier application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 25.08.2022.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is in jail since 30.07.2018.
The appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the crime in question.
The trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record.
The final disposal of this appeal would take considerable time.
Hence, it is prayed that sentence of the appellant be suspended and he be released on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the application.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that there is no change in circumstances after dismissal of earlier application except the custody period, this Court is not inclined to allow this application.
Accordingly, I.A. No.20120/2022 is hereby dismissed.
(SMT. ANJULI PALO) JUDGE Prachi Govind Chakravarty vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52461834/
